internalDomain.description: Base domain for internal service hostnames.

storageClass.description: StorageClass for data the volume must protect. Empty uses the cluster default.

localStorageClass.description: StorageClass for data the application replicates itself or can re-derive. Empty uses the cluster default.

namespaceLabels.description: Extra labels on every namespace this layer creates (policy: all of namespaces.create; platform: garage.createCredentialsNamespaces). Labels the chart sets itself are refused.

ingress.description: Ingress for this layer's UIs. Hostnames derive from global.internalDomain.

className.description: Empty uses the cluster default IngressClass.

forwardAuth.description: Put Authentik forward-auth in front of this console's route (consoles with no sign-in of their own). The render fails if the identity capability is off; false routes it with no sign-in.
Forward-auth (TM-0425): which Authentik Middleware a console route attaches.

middleware.description: Provider-qualified Traefik Middleware. Empty uses the identity layer's on a stock install: tockmox-authentik-tockmox-forward-auth@kubernetescrd.

address.description: Address the Traefik dashboard's own forward-auth Middleware asks (an IngressRoute cannot attach the identity layer's Middleware across namespaces). Empty uses the identity layer's Authentik server on a stock install.

enabled.description: true or false to decide explicitly; unset or null to follow the owning capability.

propertyNames.description: Generated by tools/check-values-typos.sh --write: every component name any layer declares (TM-0404).

cert-manager.description: Upstream cert-manager chart values, passed through unchanged.

selfSigned.description: The bootstrap self-signed CA. The shape of the on-ramp, not the contract, with one exception: `name`.

name.description: The ClusterIssuer name every layer's global.certIssuer points at. Contract: other layers address this by name, and cert-issuer.yaml fails the render when it is empty.

garage.description: Tockmox-owned block: the shipped object store used as the backup target, and (garage.web) the static sites it serves.

createCredentialsNamespaces.description: Copy-target namespaces (garage.credentialsNamespaces) that this layer creates itself, at sync wave -3, because nothing else creates them before it syncs. Empty by default: the two default targets are created by the policy layer. Every name must also be in credentialsNamespaces; do not name one the policy layer creates.

blockSize.description: Garage block_size, a string with units such as 10MiB, or a byte count. Empty renders no block_size line, so Garage uses its own default (1MiB in v2.4.1 per upstream's reference, not measured here). Only objects uploaded after a change use the new size; see values.yaml.

web.description: Garage web endpoint (port 3902) and the static sites it serves (TM-0215). Off unless apps.docs resolves true, enabled is true, or sites yields a site.

enabled.description: Force the endpoint on with no site listed.

rootDomain.description: Garage s3_web root_domain. Empty derives .web.<global.internalDomain>. No site host may end with it.

syncSchedule.description: Cron schedule of the per-site sync CronJobs. A CronJob, not an Argo hook, so a failed sync never fails the platform sync.

syncAtInstall.description: Also publish each site once when the bootstrap Job runs, by starting a Job from the sync CronJob (best effort, not waited for), so a fresh install's site is not empty until the first tick.

sites.description: Helm replaces a list rather than merging it: restate the docs entry if you set your own. The site named docs is the product documentation: no content.image, writerKey true.

name.description: DNS label, at most 32 characters (the sync CronJob tockmox-garage-sync-<name> may have 52). Names the Ingress, the writer Secret and the sync CronJob. Unique.

host.description: The Host the site answers on and the bucket's global alias. Empty derives <name>.<global.internalDomain>. At most 63 characters.

errorDocument.description: Object served on a 404. Empty means none.

ingress.description: Render an Ingress routing host to the Garage Service port 3902.

writerKey.description: Mint a read/write key scoped to this bucket into the Secret tockmox-garage-site-<name>. The docs site always gets one.

content.description: What fills the bucket. image names an image holding a site of your own under path, synced by a CronJob; empty means someone else fills it (for the docs site, tools/publish-docs.sh).

dbEngine.description: Garage metadata engine (TM-0817). Must match the engine that wrote an existing meta directory; the pod's engine guard refuses a mismatch.

credentialsNamespaceLabels.description: Per-namespace labels for the namespaces in createCredentialsNamespaces, keyed by namespace name; merged over global.namespaceLabels. At least pod-security.kubernetes.io/*.

plugin-barman-cloud.description: Upstream plugin-barman-cloud chart values, passed through unchanged.

enabled.description: Unset means components follow this capability; true or false overrides.

observability.description: Metrics, logs, and the ServiceMonitor/PrometheusRule objects this repo writes. Decline it and set apps.serviceMonitors.enabled to keep the monitors for your own Prometheus operator.

enabled.description: Unset means components follow this capability; true or false overrides.

notifications.description: Alerts that reach a person: the sink, the bridge and the heartbeat that proves the path. Its component switch is notifications.enabled, which predates this framework.

enabled.description: Unset means components follow this capability; true or false overrides.

identity.description: Single sign-on across every console, and the identity provider behind it.

enabled.description: Unset means components follow this capability; true or false overrides.

aiPlane.description: The private AI plane: the chat console and the model gateway in front of it.

enabled.description: Unset means components follow this capability; true or false overrides.

dataProtection.description: Backups that go somewhere, and the object store, backup plugin and snapshot control plane underneath them.

enabled.description: Unset means components follow this capability; true or false overrides.

hardwareTelemetry.description: SMART and SNMP telemetry from physical hardware. Off by default, because the reference deployment is a virtual machine.

enabled.description: Unset means components follow this capability; true or false overrides.

workflowAutomation.description: Scheduled and event-driven jobs inside the cluster, with a console to watch them.

enabled.description: Unset means components follow this capability; true or false overrides.

networkPolicy.description: Default-deny between namespaces. Decline it on a CNI that does not enforce NetworkPolicy, where these objects are decoration.

capabilities.description: Named functional capabilities: one switch per functional story, spanning whatever components it takes across whichever layers they live in. CLOSED, unlike `global`: nothing upstream reads this block, so an unrecognised name here is always a typo, and an ignored typo means a capability you thought you declined is still on. See docs/administration/capabilities.md.

snapshot-controller.description: Upstream snapshot-controller chart values, passed through unchanged.

probes.description: Blackbox Probe objects. The exporter shipped with none, so it ran and measured nothing.

module.description: A module name from the blackbox exporter's own config.

consoles.description: Subdomain under global.internalDomain -> probe it or not.

$comment: The ROOT is closed: a key that is neither a Tockmox block, a chart dependency, nor another layer's block is a typo, and a typo in a top-level key used to be accepted in silence.
